budgets.name: Council Core Functions Budget (Q2-Q3 2026)
budgets.description: Timeboxed council scope/budget per Matt's core-functions synthesis (project rc-scope-budget). Lines: toolkit/knowledge commoning $800, network connection + hub $350, long-term treasury $250, hub self-hosting $250, activity reports/Karma GAP $250, hub setup retro (Afo) $150, meeting distillation $100, polls/community $100, infra $100, operations $100. Capital available ~$2,600; surplus distributed as retro. UPDATE 2026-07-29: hub self-hosting line ($250 placeholder) resolved — migration complete, actual infra cost ~$8.40/mo (~$100/yr) vs ~$100/mo on Discourse managed hosting, saving ~$1,100/yr; the $250 line now covers labour (build + ongoing ops), not hosting.
